title: MiniMax H3 short-drama episode storyboard
description: Input for scripts/validate_episode.py and scripts/build_prompts.py. Asset references in text use {asset_id} placeholders; <Subject N>/<Picture N> labels are assigned at build time in wiring order (characters, scene, props, then audio).

style.description: Opening style sentence reused by every segment unless overridden

identity_phrase.description: Invariants only (age, bone structure, hair, outfit colours); reused verbatim in every segment

reference_images.description: face, outfit/full body, optional detail; paths relative to this JSON

voice_reference.description: 2–15 s clean speech; attached only in segments where the character speaks

description.description: Written once, pasted unchanged; no people

reference_images.description: A prop without an image WILL be invented by the model

rarity.description: UI tier overlaid in post, never rendered

duration.description: Seconds; snapped to the 17k+5 frame grid at build time

continuity.description: State inherited from the previous segment (positions, props held, light); must not be empty after segment 1

end_state.description: Named end state for the next segment; no trailing period needed

negatives.description: Avoid; prefer positive locks. Rendered as a positive sentence if present

start.description: Seconds within the segment; shot 1 must be 0; each shot ≥ 1.2 s

camera.description: One dominant move in official vocabulary, as a sentence

action.description: ≥ 8 words, starting state → movement → ending state, ends with a period
